case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your past price support and for explaining the labour and material pressures behind your quote. We recognise that sustainable supply requires more than recovering current cost increases.

By the figures you gave us - LCI-C +2.7% at 30% of your cost, PPI-C241 +6.5% at 24% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.4%, not the 9.5% you ask for. German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Our options treat the index evidence as a starting point, not a ceiling on sustainable pricing, while giving both sides predictable terms. We are flexible on payment terms; which option best supports your planning?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 131.87 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 131.93 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our history and welcome your office manager’s perspective on the costing.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We appreciate your detailed review of the indices and acknowledge the recent decrease in energy costs, which we have incorporated into our revised calculation.

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. While we do not share proprietary internal cost breakdowns, please be assured that our pricing accurately reflects the necessary expenses to maintain the high quality you expect from our foundry. 

We are pleased to offer a revised price of €135.50 per unit with 30-day payment terms, representing a fair compromise based on the data provided. Our current offer is a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for lowering your offer after checking the indices and recognising the fall in energy costs. We acknowledge the remaining labour and material pressures, respect your costing confidentiality, and remain grateful for your past price support.

We have made a modest upward price step and are flexible on payment terms, asking for a further price concession from you in exchange for faster payment. Option B provides your requested standard payment term; which package works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 133.56 per unit, payment 90 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option B: EUR 133.05 per unit, payment 30 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.
Option C: EUR 133.38 per unit, payment 45 days net, new price from 2026-11-01.

We hope this reciprocal step supports sustainable supply and the relationship our companies have built.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your upward step and your understanding of the ongoing material and labour pressures we face. In recognition of your movement, we are prepared to offer a further concession to a price of €134.50 per unit. 

We prefer to maintain our standard 30-day payment terms, as this provides the predictability we need for our operations. For our complete Angebot, we propose a price of €134.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Thomas Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your further concession and past support; we recognise your need for predictable payment. We retain your standard terms, and the labour index below forms part of our calculation, not a limit on sustainable pricing.

The German labour cost index for manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

We are making a modest price step and are flexible on the effective date, offering an earlier start in exchange for a lower price. Option B gives your requested start date; which package works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 138.74 per unit, new price from 2027-04-01, payment 30 days net.
Option B: EUR 133.69 per unit, new price from 2026-11-01, payment 30 days net.
Option C: EUR 135.13 per unit, new price from 2027-01-01, payment 30 days net.

We appreciate your continued willingness to find a practical agreement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. As to the index change data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We appreciate your upward step and your confirmation of the labour cost index data we provided earlier. As this data confirms our initial assessment of the ongoing labour pressures, our room for further movement is limited. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €135.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. To reach an agreement, we are prepared to offer a price of €134.10 per unit, maintaining the 1 November 2026 start date and our standard 30-day payment terms. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
